svg.title: Attribution occupies the space between false and verified
svg.desc: Locate attributed primary documentation between the two rejected certainty extremes. Avoid success/failure iconography that accidentally declares the claim verified or false.

**Font:** `uncertainty`

> AN INSTITUTION’S ACCOUNT CAN BE DETAILED AND CONSEQUENTIAL WITHOUT AN OUTSIDE INVESTIGATOR HAVING SEEN THE UNDERLYING RECORD. THE BOOK KEEPS THE CLAIM AND THE LIMIT ON ITS CORROBORATION TOGETHER.
